summary: Comprehensive testing of KOYA Market e-commerce modifications. All 35 backend tests passed. Frontend UI tests verified all requested features are working correctly.

navigation_menu.details: 'Accueil' is NOT present in navigation menu. Menu contains: Catalogue, Recettes, Qui sommes-nous, Contact, KÔYA Pro

zone_checker_postal_codes.details: Zone checker accepts 5-digit postal codes (not city names). Tested: 75011 (complete), 91000 (complete), 78000 (partial), 13001 (not eligible)

promo_code_field.details: Cart page shows 'Code promo' input field with 'Appliquer' button

loyalty_code_field.details: Cart page shows 'Code fidélité' input field with 'Appliquer' button and placeholder 'Code FIDELITE-XXXXXXXX'

promo_bienvenue10.details: BIENVENUE10 returns valid=true with 10% discount. UI shows 'BIENVENUE10 (10% de réduction)' and applies -5.70€ discount

promo_koya20.details: KOYA20 returns valid=true with 20% discount (backend verified)

promo_invalid.details: Invalid promo code returns 400 error. UI shows 'Code invalide - Code promo invalide' toast

loyalty_generate_insufficient_points.details: Generate-code fails when user has < 100 points. Button shows 'Il vous manque 100 points' and is disabled

loyalty_redeem_invalid.details: Redeem endpoint rejects invalid loyalty codes with 400 error

user_registration_login.details: User registration and login work correctly. Tested with carttest@koya.com

cart_functionality.details: Adding products to cart works. Cart displays items with quantities and prices

homepage.details: Homepage loads correctly with hero section, zone checker, popular products, categories, recipes

catalogue.details: Catalogue loads with 16 products, category filters, origin filter, search functionality

context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested modifications have been implemented and tested: 1) 'Accueil' removed from nav, 2) Zone checker uses postal codes with correct coverage logic, 3) Cart has promo code field, 4) Cart has loyalty code field, 5) Loyalty page has generate code button. Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_koya_features.py cover all API endpoints.
